title: First dates with Nat Cole at the Tiffany Club
summary: Lee says he played the Tiffany Club with Nat only briefly when he first joined, with no rehearsal, before the group left on the road.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Now up to Nat. You mentioned playing Cyros here -- you also played the Tiffany Club several times, didn't you?
It seems like I remember seeing you there more than once.
No. Not really. See, that was when I was supposed to join them. No, he still had Jack Costanza then.
It seems that I remember you at the Tiffany Club.
Yeah, once. Yes. Once. That's when

I first joined them. That is correct. The Tiffany -- we played the Tiffany. I think I played with him there like for 5 nights or something, and then we went on the road. That's when I joined him. But when you join a group like that, you don't do anything but bring your instrument in, you have no rehearsal, no nothing, you know.
